name: Lavender Latte
caffeineNote: No caffeine figure published for this flavor; the Mocha on the same base prints 180 mg on its label
summary: Lavender latte on the same oatmilk cold brew base as Great Lakes' Mocha, at 140 calories with 15 g of sugar — all of it added — and 1 g of protein per 11 fl oz can. Figures are from the panel the brand publishes rather than a can we have held, and no caffeine figure is published for this flavor, so that column stays blank until we check one.
